release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.21 refines the all-in suspense sequence: already-dealt community cards stay visible. A flop all-in opens both hands, asks the player to choose Run It Once/Twice/Three Times, then reveals only the turn and river with deliberate pauses; a preflop all-in reveals flop, turn, and river in order. For multiple runouts, each board starts from the already-shared street and reveals only its remaining cards. Winner banners, POT PAID, stack changes, and payouts stay hidden until the final river. The v1.5.19 one-time +$1,100 wallet credit and v1.5.18 pot visibility fix are preserved.
